_doc: Step Inside Phase 2: visit model of the Torres Vedras house (test project, another architect's design) on its surveyed lot. The survey DWG (converted to DXF on the PC) holds the proposal in real coordinates: the house is placed by fitting the model's walls to the walls' hatches. Run after terreno.py: python step-inside/ferramentas/visita/visita.py step-inside/projetos-teste/torres-vedras/visita.json

implantacao._nota: Only around the copy of the drawing at the real coordinates (the lot boundary chosen by terreno.py).
